Subject: Request: compute extension for longitudinal student mental-health NLP pilot

Hi Aditya,

Thanks again for the trial credits earlier this year — the Greenbridge NLP Lab has been running a pilot analyzing longitudinal, de-identified student text to detect early signs of distress. The pilot was originally a 6-week trial; we've exceeded the test quota and have produced promising signals in early evals.

We need an extension to complete model selection and run a full longitudinal evaluation over the fall term. Specifically, we're requesting an additional allocation suitable for roughly 4 months of continuous experimentation (~200k tokens of generation and 30k embedding units). We have an IRB approval on file (attached) and a CSV usage report showing current token consumption (attached as usage_report_q2.csv).

A few quick notes:
- All student data is anonymized and stored locally; we only send short aggregated text windows to Redwood for inference.
- We are not working with PHI; this is student-reported text collected under university consent.
- The work is grant-funded (NSF supplement) and we can provide PO info if a paid plan is required after the extension.

Could you advise on what approval/data controls you need from us and whether a temporary extension or promotional allocation is possible? We are on a tight timeline to finish evaluation before the winter term.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a 20-minute call if useful.

Best,
Prof. Lena Ortiz
Director, NLP Lab
Greenbridge University

Attachments: IRB_GB_NLP_2026.pdf (application/acrobat), usage_report_q2.csv (text/csv)
